title: Evaluate the inverse of a linear function
source: Theory P1-2.3 Quick check 1 (f(x)=3x-1, f^{-1}(8)=3); book three-step method on printed p.44, new numbers
stem: If \(f(x)={a|int}x+{b|int}\), what is the value of \(f^{-1}({y|int})\)?

steps.name: A
steps.note: V is (y-b)/a and is an integer by the constraint. Original: (8-(-1))/3=3.

title: Evaluate a self-inverse linear function
source: Theory P1-2.3 Quick check 2 (f(x)=5-x is self-inverse, f^{-1}(2)=3); book self-inverse remark on printed p.44, new numbers
stem: The function \(f(x)={k|int}-x\) is self-inverse. What is the value of \(f^{-1}({n|int})\)?

title: Lower end of the domain of an inverse
source: Theory P1-2.3 Quick check 3 (f(x)=sqrt(x+2)-7 for x>=-2, domain of inverse is x>=-7); book Worked example 2.7 style, new numbers
stem: The function \(f\) is given by \(f(x)=\sqrt{(x+{p|int})}-{q|int}\) for \(x\geqslant -{p|int}\). The domain of \(f^{-1}\) is \(x\geqslant k\). What is the value of \(k\)?

steps.name: A
steps.text_tex: The range of \(f\) is \(f(x)\geqslant -{q|int}\), so the domain of \(f^{-1}\) is \(x\geqslant -{q|int}\). Thus \(k={K|int}\).

title: Inverse of a restricted quadratic, and the domain of the inverse

source.note: Stem taken from the QP PDF (UCLES 2020), Question 9(b) only, including the sentence that defines f. Official answer and mark allocation from the MS PDF. The item is paper/self-mark. Parts 9(a), 9(c) and 9(d) are omitted.

stem:
This question is 9709/12/F/M/20 Question 9(b), taken from the official QP.

The function \(f\) is defined by \(f(x)=2x^2+12x+11\) for \(x\leqslant -4\).

(b) Find an expression for \(f^{-1}(x)\) and state the domain of \(f^{-1}\).  [3]

steps.name: M
steps.text_tex: Complete the square, or rearrange \(y=2(x+3)^2-7\), to obtain \(x+3=\pm\sqrt{(y+7)/2}\).
steps.note: MS 9(b): M1 for the first two operations correct (condone a sign error, or with x/y already interchanged). Independent: 2x^2+12x+11=2(x+3)^2-7.

steps.name: B1
steps.text_tex: The given domain \(x\leqslant -4\) selects the negative square root, so \(f^{-1}(x)=-3-\sqrt{(x+7)/2}\).
steps.note: MS 9(b): A1FT for the inverse equal to minus the square root of (x+7)/2, minus 3 (FT on their completed-square constants).

steps.name: A
steps.text_tex: When \(x=-4\), \(f(-4)=-5\), and as \(x\to-\infty\), \(f(x)\to\infty\). The range of \(f\) is therefore \(f(x)\geqslant -5\), so the domain of \(f^{-1}\) is \(x\geqslant -5\).
steps.note: MS 9(b): domain x >= -5, or equivalent interval notation. Do not accept y=... or f(x)=... or the inverse-function formula in place of the domain.
